mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above the prior quarter's growth rate signals stronger household demand, which raises earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline during periods when GDPC1 accelerates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces corporate profit margins and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings growth and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during INDPRO declines below its 12-month MA (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening household demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during GDPC1 declines below its 12-month MA (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average signals labor market strengthening, which boosts corporate profit margins and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline when PAYEMS exceeds its 12-month MA (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline when INDPRO exceeds its 12-month MA (t-test p > 0.05).
